about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): CrsShld1 against an attack, BN5's CanGard V1 at (6,2) free (not held: spec cangard_v1, its reticle on MegaMan's panel at t85), MegaMan at (2,2) with a folder of CrsShld1 B in both games, BN5's chip 169 by BN5's own code and the registry's 477 by the same code moved (BN5's family 0x1F as BN6's 0x6F), raised at t76: the reticle's strike met by the shield and sent back as BN5's shockwave: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md). To t98: the shield's counter deletes CanGard at t98 (hp 0), whose deletion's flash at t99 stands at the moved family's own point (BN6's arm-point records for its NameID: the virus families' track's, as chip_zsaver's).
